Penylan — Cardiff, United Kingdom

Average day Relatively safer night

In detail

South Wales Police recorded 312 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — an average of 8.1 per 1,000 residents a month, the 17th highest rate of Cardiff's 28 wards. The daytime score here is driven by vehicle crime (12), shoplifting (9), burglary (4); the evening/night score by violent crime (29), public order (13), anti social behaviour (10). Those two scores are split by offence type, not by clock time — the police feed records no time of day, so day and night here mean the kinds of crime typical of each, not counts of incidents observed then. Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Penylan safe?

Wandroz currently rates Penylan in Cardiff as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Cardiff during the day and relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Cardiff at night. This rating is derived from South Wales Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Penylan safe at night?

At night, Penylan is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Cardiff. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Penylan a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Penylan's day rating (roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Cardiff) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. Note that the Booking.com link on this page searches Cardiff, not Penylan specifically: Booking does not list this neighbourhood as a destination of its own, so check each property's address against the map above.

Is there official crime data for Penylan?

Yes. Penylan's rating is derived from South Wales Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk, not an assessment — see the note on this page for the exact figure and the methodology page for full sourcing.
